data.narrative:
Havoc AI is a Series A-stage frontier-tech company operating in the ocean and maritime sector. The company has raised $200M to date. The comparable universe consists of two private peers—Seasats and Bedrock Ocean—with no directly comparable public companies identified in the sector.

Valuation analysis relies on a stage-progression methodology, which is the applicable approach given data constraints. Using total capital raised of $200M as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the subsequent stage, the analysis implies a valuation of $400M. This reflects the standard expansion of investor returns and company risk-adjusted value between institutional funding rounds.

The triangulated valuation range spans $340M (low) to $460M (high), with a median point of $400M. The relatively tight band reflects reliance on a single methodological input; the range bounds incorporate typical variance in stage-step multiples and capital-raise proxies. Key uncertainties limiting precision include the absence of public comparables to benchmark revenue multiples or margin profiles, limited visibility into the private peer financials, and the early-stage nature of the sector itself. Refinement of this estimate would benefit from revenue or EBITDA data from Havoc AI and its peers, as well as expanded disclosure on capital deployment and unit economics.
